release_notes: The adset.pro-inspired feature batch, end to end. TikTok spend now lands by the ad account's own calendar day (was UTC; run `php aggregator_cron.php --rematch --days=30` once to re-spread history), and agencies' commission is written into every import — ROI/CPC include it from the first sync and changing the percent never rewrites history. Reports group ads by platform names instead of bare ids, with statuses, impressions, platform clicks, CPM, CTR and the new Click loss (1 − tracker visitors / platform clicks), plus a banner naming the traffic source whose revenue is not tied to ad ids. The Content Gallery grows a Creatives tab: platform-synced files with spend/revenue/ROI, per-day series, the ads that ran them, dHash near-duplicate families (a manually uploaded draft picks up metrics the moment an ad starts running it), tags, and video upload (mp4/webm up to 100 MB, signature-gated). Creatives surface in campaign reports, the campaign editor, the Ads Manager extension, the Telegram digest (top/worst + burnout alerts) and MCP tools. PWA landings auto-leave the Facebook/Instagram/TikTok in-app browsers into a real one (renderer v19+), continuing the SAME click; the builder gains RTL and a poster video. Push engagement gets honest: view events from the device itself, conversion attribution per push within a configurable window, {offer.value} macros from the offer's per-country table, and sending at the subscriber's local time with quiet hours. The FB comment cleaner hides spam under ad posts by rule sets (whole-word stop words, admin regexes, links/contacts/emoji/repeats), dry-run by default, journal with one-click restore, auto-pause on Graph rate limits. External PWA builders (PWA.Group, TSL.app, custom) work as weighted stream targets with a /eflow/<campaign> return and {eid} postbacks. The Telegram ad funnel now runs on its own bots (separate from the admin bot, own poller cron), and conversion alerts post to channels through the admin bot with HTML templates. Docs EN/RU for all of it.
